name: SurveyCTO
description_en:
SurveyCTO is a field-data collection system combining a hosted server, forms, mobile capture and downstream review. It is designed for work where collectors may be offline and records may need to inform later visits or other forms. It goes beyond a standalone questionnaire through datasets, case assignment, quality checks and review/correction workflows.

Ordinary offline capture is available across plans, but more complex offline dataset and case operations require Advanced or Enterprise. The free community subscription is described as an evaluation, testing and training sandbox, so it must not be presented as an unrestricted free production plan.
description_zh:
SurveyCTO 是面向实地数据采集的系统，结合托管服务端、表单、移动采集及后续审核。适用于采集员可能离线、已有记录还需用于后续访问或其他表单的工作，通过数据集、个案分配、质量检查和审核修订，超出独立问卷的范围。

各套餐都支持普通离线采集，但复杂的离线数据集和个案操作需要 Advanced 或 Enterprise。免费社区订阅定位为评估、测试和培训沙盒，不能写成不受用途限制的免费生产套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect locally and synchronize to the server after connectivity returns.
core_features.explanation_zh: 本地采集，恢复联网后同步至服务端。

core_features.explanation_en: Link forms and follow-up records; advanced offline workflows have higher-tier requirements.
core_features.explanation_zh: 连接表单和后续记录，高级离线流程有更高套餐要求。

core_features.explanation_en: Audit metadata, flag anomalies and review or correct submissions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过审计元数据、异常标记和审核修订检查提交。

en: Manage repeated field interviews with offline case data.
zh: 使用离线个案数据管理重复实地访谈。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Build a form, assign access and test actual submission and downstream review.
steps.zh: 创建表单、分配权限并测试真实提交和后续审核。

steps.en: Test the intended offline dataset/case path under the eligible subscription before field deployment.
steps.zh: 外出部署前，在符合条件的套餐中测试预期离线数据集与个案路径。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Subscription capacity by monthly submissions, forms and storage; extra submission and AI credits.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Basic $250 monthly/$225 annual monthly equivalent; Pro $350/$315; Advanced $700/$630. Extra 1,000 submissions $100. Trial fifteen days: ten forms, 200 submissions, 200 MB. Community is a free evaluation/testing/training sandbox with 200 monthly submissions, not verified as production use.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Basic 月付 $250/年付折合 $225；Pro $350/$315；Advanced $700/$630。额外 1,000 次提交 $100。15 天试用含 10 表单、200 次提交、200 MB；免费 Community 为评估、测试和培训沙盒，每月 200 次提交，未核实允许生产使用。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Design for the next visit as well as the current form
sections.title_zh: 同时设计本次表单与下次访问
sections.en: SurveyCTO offers an online designer and spreadsheet-based form authoring. Datasets can carry prior responses into another form, while case management assigns follow-up work. An illustrative household study would preserve a case identifier and use relevant prior information during the next visit. Test missing or changed case data and the intended collector permissions; a completed form alone does not prove the correct case was updated.
sections.zh: SurveyCTO 提供在线设计器和电子表格制表方式。数据集可把先前回答带入其他表单，个案管理负责后续工作分配。例如住户研究可保留个案标识，下次访问使用相关历史信息。应测试个案数据缺失或变化及采集员权限，表单完成不证明正确个案已更新。

sections.title_en: Separate local capture from advanced offline coordination
sections.title_zh: 区分本地采集与高级离线协同
sections.en: All plans support capturing data offline and syncing when connectivity returns. Offline dataset publishing and offline case workflows require Advanced or Enterprise. The advanced guide describes local dataset updates and Android Quick Share case transfers between devices. That is a specific workflow, not a promise that every mobile platform supports every offline transfer method. Before fieldwork, test a full disconnected round and reconciliation after reconnecting; no such test was performed here.
sections.zh: 各套餐支持离线采集及联网后同步；离线数据集发布和个案流程需 Advanced 或 Enterprise。高级指南介绍本地数据集更新，以及 Android Quick Share 设备间个案转移。这是具体流程，不能扩大成所有移动平台都支持全部传输方式。外出前应测试完整断网过程和重新联网后的核对，本文未执行该测试。

sections.title_en: Treat a quality flag as a review input
sections.title_zh: 把质量标记当作审核输入
sections.en: Features include text or audio audits, speed checks, automated anomaly detection and review/correction of submissions. These can help a reviewer find suspect data, but do not independently prove fraud or data validity. Encryption and role controls also require decisions about keys and access. Confirm who can inspect, correct and export the needed fields before giving a team production access.
sections.zh: 功能包含文字或音频审计、答题速度检查、自动异常检测，以及提交审核修订。这些帮助审核者发现可疑数据，不能独立证明欺诈或数据有效性。加密和角色控制还需要明确密钥及访问安排。给予团队生产权限前，应确认谁可以查看、修订和导出所需字段。

sections.title_en: Estimate submissions, storage and AI use separately
sections.title_zh: 分别估算提交、存储与 AI 用量
sections.en: Basic lists $250 monthly or $225 per month on annual billing, with 5,000 monthly submissions, 100 forms and 10 GB. Pro and Advanced advertise $350/$700 monthly or $315/$630 annual equivalents; Enterprise is custom. Extra submissions cost $100 for 1,000 credits, with volume discounts. AI credits have separate prepaid and on-demand rules, so unlimited users and devices do not mean unlimited processing or storage.
sections.zh: Basic 月付 $250，或年付折合每月 $225，含每月 5,000 次提交、100 个表单和 10 GB。Pro 与 Advanced 月付 $350/$700，年付折合 $315/$630；Enterprise 定制。额外 1,000 次提交额度为 $100，另有批量折扣。AI 额度有单独预付及按需规则，因此不限用户与设备不等于处理量或存储不限。

sections.title_en: Use the sandbox for evaluation, and confirm production needs
sections.title_zh: 用沙盒评估，另核生产条件
sections.en: The fifteen-day trial includes ten forms, 200 submissions and 200 MB. Community continues evaluation, testing and training with ten forms, 200 monthly submissions and 200 MB; check its contract before operational use. SurveyCTO merits investigation for supervised fieldwork, longitudinal studies and disconnected workflows. A minimal online poll may not need this operating model. The service is presented as hosted; no source license or self-managed server distribution was verified.
sections.zh: 15 天试用包含 10 个表单、200 次提交和 200 MB。Community 延续评估、测试及培训用途，含 10 个表单、每月 200 次提交和 200 MB；实际运营前需核合同。对于有监督的实地采集、纵向研究及断网流程，SurveyCTO 值得进一步了解；简易在线投票未必需要这种运行模式。服务以托管形式呈现，本次未确认源码许可或自管服务端发行版。

research_gaps: No mobile installation, offline transfer, synchronization, review workflow, encryption key handling or API was tested.
Community production-use rights, detailed tier quotas, contractual residency/retention, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
